newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda sees 1997 domestic output up 12.2%.
newsitem.headline: Honda sees 1997 domestic output up 12.2%.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Friday it expects its domestic vehicle production in 1997 to rise 12.2 percent from this year to 1.22 million vehicles, after projected growth of 12.4 percent in 1996.
Japan's third-biggest carmaker expects its domestic sales in 1997 to rise 5.5 percent from this year to 800,000 vehicles, after a projected 20.6 percent gain in 1996.
It forecast its 1997 automobile exports will rise 26.4 percent to 460,000 after a projected 16.1 percent fall this year.
It sees overseas output climbing 4.3 percent to 1.09 million units in 1997 after a projected 17.9 percent increase this year.
